name: Realty Income
description: Realty Income owns 15,511 mostly single-tenant properties (98.9% leased) in all 50 states, the UK and eight other European countries, and rents each one to its operator under a long net lease, where the tenant pays taxes, insurance and upkeep. Rent (excluding reimbursements) was $5.1B of $5.75B total 2025 revenue. About 79 percent of annualized rent is retail (convenience stores, dollar stores, drug stores, gyms, home improvement), 15 percent industrial and 3 percent gaming (two properties). The UK and Europe were about 19 percent of rent at end 2025, up from 14 percent a year earlier. It funds purchases with debt and equity and pays a monthly dividend it has raised for over 31 years. It is a financing business as much as a landlord: growth comes from the gap between its cost of capital and the initial yield on purchases (7.3 percent on Q2 2026 investments).
